control_plane_consistency.source_of_truth: wf-state.json is orchestrator-owned control-plane state; sprint, run, and verification files are contract/evidence surfaces.
control_plane_consistency.before_evaluator_dispatch: Completed and remaining waves must align between wf-state.json and .feature-workflow-run.json; sprint changed_paths must equal the union of wave files_to_modify.
control_plane_consistency.before_final_refresh: Evaluator verdict pass, remaining_waves empty, blocking proofs recorded, and final_refresh proofs not yet rerun in the same successful repair cycle.
control_plane_consistency.before_completion: wf-state.json convergence_done/completed, run final_refresh passed, sprint completed, and verification.md verdict pass must agree.

design_assumptions_affecting_proof_requi: Live llm-runner provider auth, quota, or account failures are environment evidence, not Horizon integration failures.
Contract tests are blocking for Horizon completion; live provider smoke is final_refresh evidence and may be recorded with an environment-class result.
src/ai/analyzer.py is in changed_paths only as a guarded repair target if analyzer compatibility tests expose a real fallback regression.
